description: Registry of PUBLIC_BUT_INTERNAL_ACCIDENT types with tracked remediation plans. Each entry documents why the type is still public, what fix is planned, and at which milestone it will be addressed. This registry prevents temporary architectural debt from becoming permanently invisible.

groups.description: Concrete AST node implementations in language.vtl.ast.*. Public because their sealed root interfaces (VtlNode, VtlExpression) are INTERNAL_CROSS_MODULE contracts; Java requires the permitted subtypes to be accessible for pattern matching from the consuming module (viet-template-vtl-interpreter). Cannot be made package-private without addressing the language-vtl and vtl-interpreter cross-module boundary.
groups.jpmsRelevance: Potentially useful post-boundary resolution: named module could keep hierarchy in unexported packages. Does not reduce Java public modifier on its own.
groups.candidateResolution: Candidate remedies: module consolidation, ownership restructuring, narrow internal compiler facade, representation relocation, or retained intentional cross-module contract
groups.riskIfEarlyRemoval: HIGH — changes published coordinates and cross-module API contract
groups.blockerRationale: Concrete AST nodes have 0 signature leaks into STABLE_API or STABLE_SPI and cannot be reached by public consumers. They exist exclusively as permitted subtypes of sealed hierarchies across internal modules; structural realignment is deferred to M22.

groups.description: Concrete IR statement and expression implementations in language.vtl.ir.expression.* and language.vtl.ir.statement.*. Public because their sealed root interfaces (IrStatement, IrExpression) are INTERNAL_CROSS_MODULE contracts consumed by viet-template-vtl-interpreter. Same cross-module boundary problem as AST_CONCRETE_NODES.
groups.jpmsRelevance: Same as AST_CONCRETE_NODES — boundary-level resolution required before JPMS helps.
groups.candidateResolution: Candidate remedies: module consolidation, ownership restructuring, narrow internal compiler facade, representation relocation, or retained intentional cross-module contract
groups.blockerRationale: Concrete IR implementations (13 expressions + 20 statements = 33 types) have 0 signature leaks into STABLE_API or STABLE_SPI and cannot be reached by public consumers. They serve exclusively as cross-module representations consumed by vtl-interpreter; structural realignment is deferred to M22.

groups.description: Semantics-layer types that are public due to cross-package callers within language-vtl, or cross-module use by vtl-interpreter for type-check results. Includes ForeachMetadata (the SPI interface whose production implementation lives in vtl-interpreter) and the VType sealed hierarchy (internal type system used by the optimizer).
groups.jpmsRelevance: None — visibility is cross-package within language-vtl, not a module boundary issue.
groups.candidateResolution: Evaluate whether ForeachMetadata interface can be promoted to api or runtime module; evaluate VType sealed hierarchy inlining into optimizer package for package-private containment
groups.riskIfEarlyRemoval: MEDIUM — ForeachMetadata is a cross-module SPI boundary
groups.blockerRationale: Semantics internal types (10 VType/Nullability types + 1 ForeachMetadata = 11 types) have 0 signature leaks into STABLE_API or STABLE_SPI. ForeachMetadata is frozen under the generated ABI baseline, and the internal VType hierarchy cannot be reached by public consumers; structural realignment is deferred to M22.

groups.description: Types in viet-template-vtl-interpreter that are currently classified INTERNAL_CROSS_MODULE because non-production modules (viet-template-benchmarks, viet-template-tck) use them. Production modules do NOT need these types. The contract registry marks their consumerScope as BENCHMARK or TEST. Reclassification to BENCHMARK_SUPPORT_INTERNAL / TCK_SUPPORT_INTERNAL depends on benchmark relocation prototype.
groups.jpmsRelevance: None — these are not production module boundaries; they are tooling boundaries.
groups.candidateResolution: Move slot-level benchmarks (VariableAssignmentBenchmark, NestedScopeBenchmark, VariableLookupBenchmark) to a JMH benchmark source set within viet-template-vtl-interpreter. Prototype class-loading behavior with one benchmark first before adopting broadly. For TCK: move TierDifferentialHarness white-box tests to viet-template-vtl-interpreter test scope.
groups.riskIfEarlyRemoval: LOW — not published API; only internal tooling depends on these

summary.blockerRationale: All 85 PBCIA types have 0 signature leaks into STABLE_API or STABLE_SPI, cannot be reached by public consumers, ForeachMetadata is frozen under the generated ABI baseline, and structural module realignment is deferred to M22.
summary.note: PBCIA types in this registry total 85 (AST: 41, IR: 33, Semantics: 11). 3 additional types are non-production INTERNAL_CROSS_MODULE debt targeted for M4.5 benchmark/TCK relocation. Total tracked architectural debt is 88. Types classified INTERNAL_CROSS_PACKAGE (56) are intentional and not considered debt.
